in_marathi.name: Gitashree
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Song of the Vedas
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gitashree हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Gitashree is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Gita’ which means ‘song’ and ‘Shree’ which means ‘goddess of wealth’. This name symbolizes the blessings of the Vedas, the divine knowledge passed down through the ages. It is a name that is revered in Hindu and Sanskrit cultures and is often given to girls as a sign of divine grace and wisdom.
